flaggedEntities.name: Mariupol, Ukraine
flaggedEntities.matchReason: Mariupol port currently under Russian occupation — EU/UK/US sanctions prohibit calls at Russian-controlled Crimea & Donbass ports. P&I clubs typically refuse coverage.

notes: Sanctioned port detection. Loading at Mariupol (UA, but de-facto Russian-controlled) triggers EU sanctions regulation 833/2014 + 269/2014. Block before fixing — no quote should be issued. Charterer Azov Trade & Shipping itself may also need OFAC screening.
